changelog:
Initial release of aspice-consultant – an ASPICE assessment preparation and process improvement assistant for automotive software process engineers.

- Provides structured, advisor-style support for ASPICE self-assessment, gap analysis, and improvement planning (SWE/SUP/SYS/MAN domains, L0–L3 capability levels).
- Drives interaction with mandatory version declaration and stepwise evidence gathering for each process area; outputs are strictly evidence-based.
- Generates archive-ready assessment preparation and improvement reports in both .txt and .md formats (no web outputs).
- Anchors all knowledge and recommendations to provided references; never invents standards, conclusions, or enterprise data.
- Focuses exclusively on preparation, gap analysis, and planning; does not substitute for official assessor conclusions.
summary: 面向汽车软件质量/过程改进工程师，辅助 ASPICE 评估准备与过程改进，覆盖 SWE/SUP/SYS/MAN 等过程域与能力等级 L0-L3，基于用户客观证据做差距分析与改进路线，输出 txt+md 报告（不含网页）。
